story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah. And Lyle had connections with that show, too. Benny Heath and I were in that show, and it was over in Brooklyn, at the Banks Theatre, I think. Yeah, Banks Street Theatre. But it only lasted one week. And then, of course, we were working odd jobs here and there.

Then we went to Mac Dean's. That was on Jerome Avenue. This was in '35. Now, the show was in late '34, and in '35 we started -- for three seasons we were at Maxine's. And that was a supper club up on Jerome Avenue.
What kind of club was it?

A regular -- a nightclub. And they had a lot of celebrities. Jimmy Durante, the nose, he was one of them. And Evelyn Nesbeth, you don't remember her because she was connected with Harry K. Thaw way back there, in that big scandal that time. They had a -- but she was an old-timer. She came there, one of the acts. Very difficult to play for, because she'd stop in the middle of the singing, and see somebody at a table she knew, she'd start talking to them. And then you'd wait til see got through, and then she'd pick up and the band had to grab where she left off at.
Very difficult. But she was very nice, though.
Can you tell me more about that show?
